brief: Early-1950s ranch set far back on a large wooded lot: long and low, side-gabled, with an attached one-car garage at one end, a picture window and a long gravel drive; big old trees kept from the farm field it was built on.

facade.notes: (Middletown OH appraisal snapshot, scalloped-edge print): a 1950 stone-faced ranch far back on a wooded lot, a long gravel driveway between brick gate piers up to a garage; big trees and shrubs

why.note: brick piers at the drive mark the entry on an open-fronted lot
